description: Defines the AudioStreamTrack class, an internal audio stream implementation using legacy AudioTrack, including method declarations, class members, and external dependencies.

classes.name: AudioStreamTrack
classes.description: An internal audio stream class that uses the legacy AudioTrack path, providing methods for controlling audio playback and querying stream status.

methods.name: AudioStreamTrack
methods.description: Constructor for the AudioStreamTrack class.

methods.name: ~AudioStreamTrack
methods.description: Destructor for the AudioStreamTrack class.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes the audio stream with the provided builder configuration.

methods.name: release_l
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the stream.

methods.name: close_l
methods.description: Closes the stream.

methods.name: requestStart_l
methods.description: Starts the audio stream, requires mStreamLock.

methods.name: requestPause_l
methods.description: Pauses the audio stream, requires mStreamLock.

methods.name: requestFlush_l
methods.description: Flushes the audio stream, requires mStreamLock.

methods.name: requestStop_l
methods.description: Stops the audio stream, requires mStreamLock.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp for the stream based on the specified clock ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes audio data to the stream.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the buffer size for the stream.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the current buffer size.

methods.name: getXRunCount
methods.description: Returns the count of buffer underruns/overruns.

methods.name: getFramesRead
methods.description: Returns the number of frames read from the stream.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the stream, fixed as output.

methods.name: processCommands
methods.description: Processes pending commands for the stream.

methods.name: incrementClientFrameCounter
methods.description: Increments the client's frame counter by the specified number of frames.

methods.name: doSetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for the stream.

methods.name: registerPlayerBase
methods.description: Registers the player base for the stream.

methods.name: applyVolumeShaper
methods.description: Applies a volume shaper configuration and operation (conditional on AAUDIO_USE_VOLUME_SHAPER).

methods.name: getFramesPerBurstFromDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the number of frames per burst from the device.

methods.name: getBufferCapacityFromDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer capacity from the device.

methods.name: onNewIAudioTrack
methods.description: Handles actions when a new IAudioTrack is created.
